title: Planning, drafting and editing
log: 2026-11-04T09:36:48Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: The closest bank point, Drafting and editing, is written for Year 11 and does not cover planning, which the new Year 7 point requires, so it is broader and at a different depth.

draft.title: Planning, drafting and editing
card: Writers decide what they want to say before they write. They may use a mind map or a list of main ideas in order.
A draft is a first version. The writer gets the ideas down and does not worry about getting every word perfect.
Editing improves the draft. Writers check meaning and structure first, such as whether ideas make sense and are in a good order. Then they fix spelling and punctuation.
After editing, the writer shares the final version with readers.

a.q: Priya has written a first version of her story. She now reads it to check that the ideas make sense and are in a good order. Which step is this?
a.why: Checking and improving a finished first version is editing. It is not drafting, because the draft is already written.

b.q: Leo edits his report. Which task should he do first?
opts: Check that the ideas are in a sensible order
Fix a spelling mistake in the third line
Add a missing comma in the last paragraph
Share the report with the whole class
b.why: The card says to check meaning and structure first, then spelling and punctuation. Sharing the report is publishing, which comes after editing.
b.clue: Meaning and structure come before small fixes.

b.best: Check that the ideas are in a sensible order
